static_observation.assembly: The stock saves a stack canary, stores the third argument as one byte on the stack, adds 10 to the second argument, and calls i2c_w_bytes(haptic, register, &byte, 1). It checks the canary before returning and calls __stack_chk_fail on mismatch.

static_observation.limits: KCFI identifies the stock type ID but does not resolve whether the index is int or a narrower unsigned integer. The candidate uses byte-sized arguments, matching the KCFI class shared with aw8693x_set_wav_loop. Whole-driver semantic equivalence remains unestablished.
